description: Create a new server instance. For KVM (Gen3): use serverImageNo + serverSpecCode; for the boot volume (blockStorageMappingList order 0), prefer CB2 unless the user asks otherwise — CB2 is the recommended default for Gen3 KVM (volume type cannot be changed after creation). For XEN (Gen2): use serverImageProductCode + serverProductCode, or serverImageNo + serverSpecCode. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

associateWithPublicIp.description: Associate a new public IP on creation

blockStorageMappingList.description: Block storage mapping — KVM (Gen3) only. Selects the boot volume type (order 0) and/or creates additional volumes at server creation. Recommendation: for a KVM boot volume set order 0 + blockStorageVolumeTypeCode 'CB2' unless the user asks otherwise. If omitted entirely, the API default (CB1) is used. Not supported on XEN (Gen2).

blockStorageVolumeTypeCode.description: Volume type code: CB1 | CB2 | FB1 | FB2. Use ncloud_get_block_storage_volume_types to check availability. Cannot be changed after creation.

order.description: Storage order. 0 = boot(root) volume (exactly one required when this list is set), 1-20 = additional volumes

snapshotInstanceNo.description: Snapshot instance number to create this volume from

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the server

feeSystemTypeCode.description: Fee system type (MTRAT: hourly, FXSUM: monthly)

loginKeyName.description: Login key name for SSH access

memberServerImageInstanceNo.description: Member server image instance number (custom image)

ip.description: Specific IP address for this NIC

serverImageNo.description: Server image number from ncloud_get_server_images (required for KVM/Gen3)

serverImageProductCode.description: Server image product code (legacy, XEN/RHV only)

serverProductCode.description: Server product code (legacy, XEN/RHV only, use with serverImageProductCode)

serverSpecCode.description: Server spec code from ncloud_get_server_specs (required for KVM/Gen3, e.g., c2-g3, s2-g3)

name: ncloud_create_server
